body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. It starts at Emirates Hills 2 - Dubai - United Arab Emirates.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> With Topgolf Dubai tickets in your pocket, you'll be fully equipped to prove your skills in one of the city's swankiest venues.
> This new, sprawling entertainment venue features a high-tech driving range, great music, a chef-driven menu, hand-crafted drinks and best of all, seriously unbeatable views of the Dubai Marina skyline.
>
> Choose from a range of games to suit every skill level. Beginners will enjoy seeing the Angry Birds characters as golf balls to smash down structures, defeat pigs, and earn as many points and stars as possible. Intermediate and advanced players can meet challenges to hit targets at consecutive distances.
>
> When you've smashed your goals, sit back for a drink with one of Dubai's best views!

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €62.52. It was rated 4.3 out of 5 from 57 ratings and 25 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
